item.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 24
item.description: Oil pushed lower after sliding more than 3% in the previous session on cautious optimism over efforts to end the US-Iran war.

item.title: Australia Bonds Set for Longest Rally Since June on RBA Cut Bets
item.description: Australia’s bond market is heading for its longest rally in over five months as mounting signs of economic weakness fuel bets the Reserve Bank’s next move will be an interest-rate cut.

item.title: GQG Shares Set for Record Surge in Sydney With AI Trade Revival
item.description: GQG Partners Inc.’s Australia-listed shares are on track for a record daily gain, as a rebound in the artificial intelligence trade drew investors back into Rajiv Jain’s beaten-down investment firm.

item.title: Shares in Chinese Cobalt Producers Jump After Congo Bans Exports
item.description: Shares in Chinese cobalt producers surged after the Democratic Republic of Congo slapped an export ban on the battery metal from the end of the month in a bid to arrest a price decline.

item.title: Japanese Bonds Rally Across Curve as Domestic Stocks Surge
item.description: Japanese government bonds rallied across the curve after a three-day holiday, with gains holding even as domestic equities surged on easing concerns over the outlook for artificial intelligence investment.
